title: Fully satisfying a Unique Games instance
statement: A labeling of the variables by elements of the domain fully satisfies a finite Unique Games instance if, for every constraint occurrence, applying its permutation to the label of its target gives the label of its source.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Unique Games instance over a domain of size $q$ is given
A labeling from its variables to the domain is given
